guards.rule: API046 resolves wallet origin/active rental from storage; caller cannot change imported/new_travel classification. Operators inspect safe status only; preparationContext and ownerChecks unavailable to them. Required recovery unresolved means no actionable preparation/new commit.

RT01 locks shared rental/device/epoch/checklist/fence gates and commits job grantIssued monotonic + immutable grant + idempotency/outbox before return. Device accepts only exact same live prepare bootNonce/session/elapsed bound + physical approval; reboot/expired local prepare cannot accept stale delivered grant. Journaled job resumes its own erase/verification, never starts another job.

Grant-issued cannot abort/clear fence merely on timeout or unknown acceptance. Expired clearance blocks new commit; existing verified post-reset evidence can still be accepted using original grant records, current restricted relay auth and original job/epoch.

RT02/03 require independent current primary authentication, exact historical rental relationship or scoped operator, registered holder key and current job trust. Challenge binds actor/session revision/job/purpose/key; one-time issue with idempotent outcome. Stale authority is not bootstrap auth. requestedPurpose is intent; server chooses actions. No public deviceId-only issuance.

evidence_relay authority uses original previousEpoch; completion_cleanup uses verified nextEpoch. At post-reset recovery device matches previousEpoch only against preserved original journal; cleanup compares actual nextEpoch/marker. ACK may use original evidence authority matching journal or new completion_cleanup authority matching verified nextEpoch. New rental binding or newer epoch forbids old job BLE commands; old owner gets historical safe server record only.

RT04 verifies sender signature with client nonce/freshness and current authority before issuing server one-time challenge bound to authority/holder/job/action/business payload digest/idempotency key. Its issuance needs no prior server request challenge. API047/RT05/RT06 consume server challenge and fresh sender replay atomically with business outcome; profile must define normalized payload excluding recursive proofs/challenges, including exact encrypted object digest and business identity.

HTTP nested requestId/idempotencyKey/job/authority must match header/path/credential and stored rental association. Fresh retries use new sender proof/request challenge; business idempotency ignores transport nonce/proof wrappers but fixes exact source/evidence bytes/digest. Same key different business payload conflicts; current authority always checked before replay.

API047 verified evidence acceptance records server completion/revokes old binding/returns rental, but holds reuseGate awaiting_cleanup. completion ACK encrypted/protected transport, no keys/audio/addresses to operator. verification_pending/quarantined is not returned/eligible. Later original evidence duplicate returns same ACK/outcome with current auth; never repeat erase.

RB05 validates exact ACK job/commit/evidence/nextEpoch, persists minimal completion marker and removes detailed journal/private relay state per selected profile; cleanup identity permits remain enough to prove cleanup. Marker missing never infers clean. RT05/RB06 bind fresh cleanup challenge/ackDigest/completionHandle; RT06 verifies exact current epoch before setting eligible.

ReturnView derives job/gate/binding/device facts under one authority-consistent read, with view/source revisions. Readiness eligible requires completed+cleanupVerified+epoch matches+no active binding+unprovisioned_ready and gate open. Historical/unknown view returns readiness null, no new binding/account details. View is guidance, not enrollment permission.

API045 subsequent rental mutation must lock current device/gate and CAS expected nextEpoch/gateRevision/bindingRevision + operator permission/no active rental. This admission request delta is pending detailed design; initial factory enrollment has separate trusted genesis path, not fabricated reset evidence. UI new rental remains unsupported until admission contract adopted.

RT07 needs read_job_progress; ACK returned only with independent relay_completion_ack action and matching job; no readiness/owner checks. GET may consume security replay metadata, no business reset/cleanup change. ACL checked on response delivery; replay result is not public download.

RB03 pre-auth recovery connection exposes only a fresh ephemeral device challenge and discovery handle. holder signs exact device/server identities+job+authority+epoch+session nonce transcript; device/server profile must authenticate device too. This pre-auth challenge step and encrypted frame integrity/sequence/fragmentation are mandatory selected-profile work, not existing owner session downgrade.

RA05 cancel has no safe full endpoint yet: disabled until grant-never-issued plus server/device fence-release acknowledgement protocol. RA03 external-access/receipt/passkey checks reference their existing domains; no blanket force-pass. No auto import/create/backup/export in return flow.

Proposed override of original ProtectedEvidence authentication-context prose: immutable device-to-verifier ciphertext AAD binds original job/commit/device/previousEpoch/nextEpoch/eraseProfile/verifier recipient and evidence kind, not renewable relay authority or HTTP challenge. Current holder sender proof binds authorityId/requestChallenge/ciphertext digest/business identity on every submission. Exact encoding and cryptographic profile remain unselected; do not combine old AAD rule with this route order. ProtectedEvidence shape is reused, original narrative remains pinned historical candidate.

API091 proposal is opt-in projection=return; absent projection retains baseline rental/checklist/lastResetState response and original ACL. With opt-in, exact rental with no return job gives view=null. Explicit jobId must belong to this rental and be authorized or give non-enumerating error. GET never creates a job. API046 externalAccessProof remains a stored ProofReference, resolving server-side owner/rental/profile/validity, not an arbitrary reset proof.

RB03 carries HolderKey. Device validates selected key encoding/profile, recomputes thumbprint from canonical public key, compares with server-signed authority holderKeyThumbprint, and verifies holder transcript proof using that key. RT02 server registry or caller-provided thumbprint alone is insufficient device trust. Server key, device identity and freshness profile must be established separately.
